programs.name: Homestead Exemption for Disabled Veterans

exemptionValue.quote: The value of the homestead exemption for the 2025-2026 assessment years is $49,100.
exemptionValue.note: 2027-2028 amount not yet published; KRS 132.810(2)(e) requires DOR to recompute the $6,500 constitutional base for CPI every two years.

ratingRequired.quote: A service-connected totally disabled veteran of the United States Armed Forces ... shall not be required to apply for the homestead exemption on an annual basis.
ratingRequired.note: Eligibility is 'classified as totally disabled' under a federal program with payments received for the entire assessment period (132.810(2)(c)); VA 100% schedular or IU qualifies.

survivingSpouse.quote: the applicant must own, occupy and maintain the subject property ... as of January 1 (and be 65 or totally disabled)
survivingSpouse.note: No veteran-specific survivor rule; a spouse keeps it only by qualifying on age or own disability.

details.current: Must have been receiving disability compensation for entire assessment period.
details.correct: Must have been receiving disability compensation for the entire assessment period; service-connected totally disabled veterans are exempt from the annual re-application other under-65 disabled owners face; one exemption per residential unit.
details.quote: The homeowner must apply annually to continue to receive the exemption based upon a total disability, unless: They are a veteran of the United States Armed Forces and have a service connected disability;

programs.effectiveChanges: TY2026: $49,100 (second year of the 2025-2026 cycle). TY2027-2028: new CPI-adjusted amount to be set by DOR in late 2026 (not yet published). HB 245 (2026 RS), a constitutional amendment to raise the exemption to $75,000 indexed annually from 1/1/2027, died in House committee (last action 1/15/2026 referral), so nothing is on the Nov 2026 ballot.
programs.note: This is the general Section 170 age/disability homestead; the veteran row is correct but the exemption is not veteran-specific (also available to all 65+ and totally disabled owners).
